title: Concrete leveling drop-servicing middleman
one_liner: Sell foam concrete-leveling jobs via FB ads/Nextdoor/GBP, take deposits, dispatch subcontracted crews who own the rig — sales and coordination only.
why_agent_runnable: Lead gen creatives, quote scripts, subcontractor sourcing drafts, CRM, and job dispatch checklists are agent-native. Brandon gates ads spend, hires/pay to crews, insurance/legal, and any on-site.

ops_steps.title: Geo + crew map
ops_steps.detail: Map metros with slab issues + existing foam/mudjacking crews; list public directories and capacity signals.

ops_steps.title: Brandon geo + capital box
ops_steps.detail: Pick launch metro; set max ad test budget and insurance/legal review path.

ops_steps.title: Subcontractor shortlist + SOW drafts
ops_steps.detail: Draft outreach, day-rate/job-rate SOWs, photo QA checklist — hire/pay only after Brandon gates.

ops_steps.title: Virtual quote pack
ops_steps.detail: GBP/Nextdoor/FB ad drafts, photo-quote flow, deposit script, commercial subscription pilot memo.

ops_steps.title: Ads + GBP publish gate
ops_steps.detail: Approve identity, ads spend, GBP claim, and first deposit rail.

ops_steps.title: Dispatch + QA loop
ops_steps.detail: Log leads→quotes→jobs; draft crew payouts; photo QA; customer follow-ups (send gate).

ops_steps.title: Unit econ review
ops_steps.detail: Track profit-per-job sketch vs ad CAC; propose commercial subscription or kill.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.profit_per_job_anecdote_usd: ~$1000/job cited by guest operator — anecdote only, not a target
unit_economics_sketch.crew_pay_model: per-job or day-rate to subcontracted leveling crews (negotiated)
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Asset-light only if crews + insurance are solid; deposit discipline matters. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 3: Brandon geo + budget + insurance path
Day 4: SOW + outreach drafts for 5 crews
Day 7: Brandon hire/send/ads gates for first crew + campaign
kill_criteria: No insured crew willing to sub after 10 Brandon-approved outreaches
Ad CAC exceeds contribution after 20 booked jobs
Insurance/legal blocked or Brandon declines coverage spend
Job QA failures / chargebacks exceed threshold Brandon sets
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
